Copyright (C) Free Software Foundation, Inc. and contributors.
License: GPL version 3 or (at your option) any later version. See COPYING.
Project: https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/
Release: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/releases/tag/0.14

CAD invokes dwg2dxf.exe as a separate process for DWG import only.
The exact complete corresponding LibreDWG source is provided alongside
the binary as libredwg-0.14.tar.xz. Build instructions are in README/INSTALL
and the source's Windows CI/build scripts. The archive includes the upstream
build scripts and license notices. No LibreDWG source modifications were made.
Only dwg2dxf.exe and libredwg-0.dll are deployed; no other upstream tools
or optional DLLs are required by the reader's import table.

DWG import is not a guarantee of complete preservation of unsupported,
custom/proxy, encrypted or damaged objects. CAD's 2D renderer has its own
entity support limits. Use a professional CAD reader for critical comparison.
